functions.name: accounts
functions.description: List Tony's own accounts (gmail, Slack) with their platform, and whether each answers a login now (`live`, else `error`).

functions.name: channels
functions.description: List an account's chats: Slack channels, and DMs with `include_dms`; Gmail mailboxes and labels.

functions.name: fetch
functions.description: Read an account's latest messages live, oldest first, with attachment metadata. Gmail reads INBOX, from one sender when `channel` is an address; `before` is an exclusive UID. Slack reads one chat; `before` is a ts. Nothing is marked read.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Search an account's own index live: Gmail's search syntax over All Mail, or Slack search.messages. Returns matches with attachment metadata.

functions.name: download_attachments
functions.description: Download a message's attachments to a fresh temp dir on the node you call from (outside the awm workspace). Re-fetches the message live; returns `dir` and each file's `path`, `filename`, `mime`, `size`. Files together may not pass 24 MiB. `idx` selects one attachment. A Gmail `message_id` is the Message-ID header.

functions.name: draft
functions.description: Save a Gmail draft for Tony to finish and send himself; nothing is sent. `file` attaches a file from your own node (an absolute path); `files` attaches several, each a path on your node; `bucket_files` attaches drive files as [{bucket, path}]. 24 MiB in all. `reply_to` (a Message-ID) threads it as a reply and fills `to` and `subject` from that message unless given. Returns the draft's Message-ID.

functions.name: chat_read
functions.description: Read Tony's Slack, Teams or Discord through his signed-in tab in alcor's browser. Without `chat`, lists the site's chats as {id, name, kind}. With `chat` (an id, or a name that matches one chat), returns its last `limit` messages, oldest first, with each attachment's `idx`. Discord's tab opens for the call and closes after it.

params.name: chat
params.description: A chat id or name. Omit to list the chats.

functions.name: chat_download
functions.description: Download a chat message's attachments to a fresh temp dir on the node you call from. `message_id` is the `id` chat_read gave; `idx` selects one attachment. 24 MiB in all.

functions.name: chat_stage
functions.description: Put files in a chat's compose box in alcor's browser for Tony to send himself; nothing is sent. `file` is a path on your own node, `files` several, `bucket_files` drive files as [{bucket, path}]. 24 MiB in all. Returns a screenshot of the tab as a file, so you can check the files landed. Tony sends through `browser viewer`.

functions.name: buckets
functions.description: List configured cloud file-store buckets (Google Drive) with kind and root. Each is probed now: `live` is false, with an `error`, when the store does not answer.

functions.name: bucket_ls
functions.description: List the immediate children of a folder in a bucket. `path` is relative to the bucket root (omit for root). A missing path is a not-found error, a file is a not-a-folder error. Returns entries with name, path, is_dir, size, mime, web_url. `recursive=true` walks the whole tree instead, stopping at `limit` entries (default 1000) and setting `truncated` when more exist.

functions.name: bucket_stat
functions.description: Return the entry for one file or folder in a bucket, or a not-found error. Paths as for bucket_ls.

functions.name: bucket_mkdir
functions.description: Create the folder at `path` in a bucket, with every missing parent. Succeeds on an existing folder. Paths as for bucket_ls.

functions.name: bucket_get
functions.description: Download a file from a bucket. A file up to 24 MiB lands in a fresh temp dir on the node you call from, as `files[0].path`. A bigger file, or a folder, downloads to a temp dir on alcor (`node`), any size, streamed in chunks; a folder refuses over `limit` entries (default 10000) and lists the files that fail in `failures`. Google-native docs are exported (Docs→pdf, Sheets→csv).

functions.name: bucket_put
functions.description: Upload to `path` in a bucket, creating or overwriting it. `file` is a path on the node you call from, up to 24 MiB. `src` is a path on alcor instead, any size, streamed in chunks; a folder there uploads as the folder `path`, and files that fail are listed in `failures`. `parents=true` creates missing folders above `path`; without it a missing folder is a not-found error. Returns the resulting entry.

functions.name: bucket_rm
functions.description: Delete the file/folder at `path` in a bucket.

functions.name: bucket_mv
functions.description: Move or rename the file or folder `src` to `dst` in a bucket. `dst` is the full new path, not a folder to move into. Paths as for bucket_ls. Sharing goes with the item. An existing `dst` is an error unless `overwrite=true`, which first moves it to the trash. `parents=true` creates missing folders above `dst`. Returns the new entry.

functions.name: bucket_cp
functions.description: Copy the file or folder `src` to `dst` in a bucket. Arguments and errors as for bucket_mv. Returns the new entry.

functions.name: bucket_search
functions.description: Search a bucket for files whose name contains `query`, across the whole drive. Returns matching entries. A `path` scope is refused.
